transcript.content: Hello, I’m glad you came in. What brings you in today?

Hi. Um, well, I guess I'm here because things have been really hard at work lately. I do hair, and... I don't know, my hands just feel like they’re moving through glue. Even just basic stuff, like sectioning someone's hair or mixing color, it just takes me forever now. People have actually started noticing that I’m just slower than I used to be. So, yeah, that's mainly why I came in.
Have you been feeling down or depressed lately?

Yeah, I have. Most days I just wake up with this heavy, flat sadness right in my chest. It just feels like... I don't know, like there's no point in even trying to build the life I was planning for myself.
Have you ever had a period when you felt unusually high, energetic, or irritable compared with your normal self?
No, I haven't. I don't think I've ever felt like that. It's really just been the opposite, mostly... just feeling low and tired. I haven't had any times where I felt super energetic or high.
Do your movements also feel stiff or rigid?

Um, no, not stiff exactly. It's more like what I was saying before... my hands just feel like they're moving through glue. Like even basic stuff, like sectioning someone's hair or mixing color, it just takes me forever now. It's not that I can't bend my fingers, it's just... I'm so much slower. People have definitely started noticing.
Have you started any new medications recently?
Um, no, I haven't. I haven't started taking anything new recently.
Do you have any shaking or tremor in your hands?
No, my hands don't shake. I haven't noticed any tremors or anything like that. They're just slow and heavy, like I said, but they're steady.
Have you ever had a period of at least several days when you felt unusually energized and needed much less sleep than usual?
No, I haven't. I've never really felt like that. Usually, I just feel exhausted all the time. I've never had a time where I felt super energized or didn't need to sleep.
Have you ever had a similar episode of depression before this one?
No, I haven't. I mean, I've had bad days before, just like anyone, but nothing like this. This is the first time I've ever felt this low for this long.
